en: Resists forced displacement. Accepted control builds poise pressure while Stop and Rift remain useful.
zh_CN: 抵抗强制位移；生效控制积累失衡压力，时间停止和裂隙仍有效。

en: An accepted hit strengthens up to two nearby allies briefly, with a source cooldown and no stacking.
zh_CN: 命中玩家后短暂强化最多两个附近同伴；受来源冷却限制，效果不叠加。

en: Elite health increases by 50%; knockback resistance rises within its cap, while movement slows.
zh_CN: 精英生命提高50%，击退抗性在上限内提升，移动速度降低。

en: Deals 25% more damage and moves 15% faster, but takes 20% more damage.
zh_CN: 伤害提高25%，移动速度提高15%，但受到的伤害提高20%。

en: Periodically warns and creates one short-lived mirror. Only one owned mirror can remain alive.
zh_CN: 周期性预警并生成一个短暂镜像；同一来源最多保留一个存活镜像。

en: Time Stop becomes a delay and vulnerability window; Rift, time damage, and echoes remain effective.
zh_CN: 时间停止转化为延迟与易损窗口；裂隙、时间伤害和残影仍然有效。

en: Heals 3% of maximum health every two seconds, up to 30% per encounter. Heavy hits interrupt recovery.
zh_CN: 每两秒恢复最大生命的3%，每场最多恢复30%；重击可中断恢复。

en: A shield equal to 30% of maximum health can regenerate once. Breaking it exposes the owner.
zh_CN: 拥有相当于最大生命30%的护盾，只能再生一次；破盾使本体暴露。

en: Final defeat releases two short-lived ordinary copies without affixes or separate rewards.
zh_CN: 最终击败后释放两个短暂普通复制体；复制体无词缀，也不提供独立奖励。

en: Warns before moving to a collision-safe nearby landing, followed by a vulnerable arrival recovery.
zh_CN: 位移前发出预警，移动到附近无碰撞落点，随后进入可受击的恢复期。

en: A rooted matriarch with breakable roots and sacs. The trunk remains reachable while the forest changes.
zh_CN: 扎根的树母拥有可破坏树根与孢囊；森林变形时，树干仍可接近并攻击。

en: One shared health bar across Smith, Furnace, and Forged forms. Cooling pools remain safe during enrage.
zh_CN: 锻工、熔炉和铸体三形态共享一条生命；狂暴期间冷却池仍提供避火路径。

en: A shielded ruin guardian with two phases. Break its cover and convert the blue core's recovery windows.
zh_CN: 持盾的遗迹守护者拥有两个阶段；破坏掩体，把蓝色核心的恢复窗口转化为攻势。

en: A watch-bearing duelist that rewinds its own limited history and responds to authentic time abilities.
zh_CN: 携带时钟的决斗者能有限回溯自身记录，并对真正生效的时间能力作出反应。

en: Three phases test space and commitment. Its reachable cores create bounded openings without disabling time powers.
zh_CN: 三个阶段考验空间与出手；可接近的核心提供有限破绽，不会封禁时间能力。

en: Marks every landing before teleporting. Each strike remains visible and can be delayed by Time Stop.
zh_CN: 闪移前标记所有落点；每次斩击都有清晰预警，并可被时间停止推迟。

en: Plants slowing thorns and lashes a fixed line. Only the caster is safe inside its own pools.
zh_CN: 布置减速荆棘并沿固定方向挥鞭；只有施法者免受自身荆棘池影响。

en: Cycles through fire, frost, and void forms. A committed attack finishes before a form can change.
zh_CN: 轮换火焰、寒冰与虚空形态；已锁定的攻击结束后才会切换形态。

en: Slams and cuts a slowing corridor. Its first lethal wound triggers one brief recovery and revival.
zh_CN: 重击并切出减速通道；第一次致命伤会触发一次短暂恢复与复活。

en: Creates seeded fast and slow fields. Pattern changes and its final slow pulse have visible warnings.
zh_CN: 生成由种子确定的快慢场；场形切换和临终减速脉冲都有可见预警。

en: Keeps its distance and spits acid. Impact and death pools remain briefly hazardous.
zh_CN: 保持距离并喷吐酸液，命中和死亡后留下短暂危险的腐蚀池。

en: Falls dormant once and leaves a breakable sigil. Destroy the sigil or defeat the revived hound to finish it.
zh_CN: 首次倒下会休眠并留下可破坏符印；破坏符印或击败复活猎犬才算最终击败。

en: Summons bounded forest creatures and fires energy bolts. Its summons retire when their owner falls.
zh_CN: 召唤数量受限的森林生物并发射能量弹；主人最终死亡时，其召唤物一同退场。

en: Uses heavy fists, fissures, and fire. Low health triggers bounded overheat and a warned final explosion.
zh_CN: 施展重拳、地裂和火焰；低生命触发有限过热和有预警的最终爆炸。

en: Fires visible phase arrows and marked rain. Its relocation ends in a vulnerable recovery.
zh_CN: 发射始终可见的相位箭与标记箭雨；位移结束后进入可受击的恢复期。

en: Opens a bounded portal pair with clear team markings. Safe arrivals and transit cooldowns limit repeated travel.
zh_CN: 开启一对有明确阵营标识的传送门；安全落点和通行冷却限制连续传送。

en: Uses recent ally health history for capped healing, without reviving the dead or undoing defeat.
zh_CN: 根据近期同伴生命记录进行有限治疗，不复活死者，也不撤销已确认的击败。

en: A stationary support that heals nearby allies and slows intruders. Its fall weakens surviving allies.
zh_CN: 固定在原地支援，治疗附近同伴并减速入侵者；死亡后暂时削弱幸存同伴。

en: Commits predicted zones before casting. Its shifting rifts offer optional travel rather than forced teleportation.
zh_CN: 施法前锁定预测区域；移动裂隙提供自愿通行，不会强制传送玩家。

en: Passes through inner ruins and prepares a consuming blast. Damage during its warning can interrupt it.
zh_CN: 穿越遗迹内部障碍并蓄力自爆；预警期间累积伤害可以打断它。

en: Burrows along a visible trail, then attacks a marked landing. Ground damage still reaches it underground.
zh_CN: 沿可见轨迹潜地，在标记落点发动伏击；地下仍会受到地面伤害。

en: Pursues intruders, sweeps its shield, then retreats. Its elite slam strikes a marked point.
zh_CN: 追击入侵者，以盾横扫后后撤。精英重击落在预先标记的位置。

en: Charges and bites. After a hit it closes its shell, then briefly exposes a weak opening.
zh_CN: 冲撞与撕咬；受击后合拢硬壳，随后短暂露出易损的开口。

en: Retreats behind obstacles to fire arrows and a visible fan. Elite arrows can pierce one obstacle or ally.
zh_CN: 借障碍后撤并射出箭矢和可见扇形弹幕；精英箭可穿透一个障碍或同伴。

en: Approaches from the flank, attacks twice, and retreats. Elite hunters call one short-lived echo.
zh_CN: 从侧翼逼近，连续爪击后撤退；精英猎手可唤出一个短暂残影。

en: Bursts into a lingering slowing pool. Every linked explosion has a separate warning.
zh_CN: 爆裂并留下持续减速池；每次连锁爆炸都保留独立预警。

en: Links up to three pairs of allies and fires threads. Breakable webs preserve an escape gap.
zh_CN: 最多维持三条同伴连线并发射丝线；可破坏的蛛网始终保留逃生缺口。

en: A short-lived copy with 20% of its parent's base health and 50% damage. It cannot summon, revive, or grant rewards.
zh_CN: 短暂复制体，拥有母体基础生命的20%与伤害的50%；不能召唤、复活或提供奖励。

en: 45 health, 7 damage, and 8 seconds of life. No recursive abilities or separate rewards.
zh_CN: 45生命、7伤害，持续8秒；不具备递归能力，也不提供独立奖励。
